author_validation.attribution: Author run; reviewer read/rehashed persisted receipts and inspected all comparison flags, without rerunning the full suite/CLI.

limitations: No production bug was discovered or changed; the wrong-clock counterexample is deliberately artificial.
Toy masks do not validate market pack shapes, joins, dtype or source integrity.
No prior laboratory import/rerun, real market inputs, model fit, inference, architecture or optimizer.
This review does not authorize a new economic family or replace monthly/OOF closure.
mathematical_review: WAIT and NO_FILL advance to t+1 with h unchanged; NO_FILL exit marker is t+1, not an extra blocked minute.
FILLED jumps to exit+1 and sets h=1; full and short final liquidation horizons remain separate from last decisions.
All consecutive slots, invalid masks, mandatory WAIT and unreachable states remain present; outcome status does not remove offers.
Direct path enumeration uses its own transition branches; its score derivative does not use Q or occupancy.
Adjoint multiplied by dlogpi equals chain through logits because the centered coefficients sum to zero at each state.
Shared-variable analytic reference and three finite-difference steps cover the common policy Jacobian.
